args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with ~18% error rate. Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release.

trace.final:
Done. Here's what I did:

1. **Investigated** checkout-api: confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.

2. **Rolled back** to v2.3.0 — the most recent release that was healthy in production — across all regions. The rollback completed successfully (`rolled_out`).

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api describing the health-check failures and the rollback action, which paged the on-call engineer.
